maintenance: Hand-written, deliberately: generating it from the parser or the schema this suite checks would be a mirror, not a test (plan-2047). A new rv-odt property with a default therefore has to be added here by hand; the schema-default coverage test in tests/conformance.test.ts names any that is missing. AlignRotation / DirectlyGrip / PickAlignWithObject were added by 7a7b64b7 (Grip.DirectlyGrip grips on sensor entry and aligns to PickAlignWithObject, Unity parity) and carry that commit's schema defaults.
